basic_details.job_title: NIT Rourkela Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Field Assistant, Junior Research Fellow and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Rourkela (NIT Rourkela) has notified 5 total vacancies, including 2 Junior Research Fellow posts on a contract basis. The engagement is purely on a temporary or contractual basis and co-terminus with the completion of the project, with a pay of 37,000.00 - 42,000.00 for the Junior Research Fellow post. Candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow position must hold a Post Graduate degree in basic science or a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course with NET/GATE or equivalent central exam, and be below 30 years as on the last date of receipt

how_to_apply: Prepare a detailed resume including qualifications, percentage of marks, division, mark sheets, certificates, research papers, and work experience.
Combine all documents and the filled application into a single PDF file.
Send the application via email to [email protected].
Mention the Advertisement Number in the subject line of the email.
Ensure submission on or before 29 October 2026. No hard copies are required to be sent to the Institute.
important_instructions: Engagement is purely temporary and co-terminus with the completion of the project. No hard copies of the application need to be sent by post. Candidates appearing for their final examination may apply, provided the qualifying degree result is submitted by 30 November 2026. Selected candidates are required to register for the Ph.D. programme. Mereness of minimum qualification does not guarantee an invitation to the interview.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment offers multiple project-based positions under the ANRF-PAIR project. The breakdown of vacancies across various roles is as follows:

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the specific educational qualifications and criteria laid down for each post: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): Post Graduate degree in basic science OR Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through National Eligibility Tests like CSIR-UGC NET including Lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE, or National Eligibility Examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DBT, DST, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER, etc. Project Manager (PM): Doctoral Degree in Science or Master’s Degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized university or equivalent, with a minimum of 5 years of experience in project management within R&D, innovation, or technology-driven environments. Field Assistant (FA): Bachelor’s Degree in any Science discipline (B.Sc.) or a 3-year Diploma in Engineering & Technology from a recognized University/Institute/Board with a minimum of 55% marks. Candidates with a Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering/Technology (B.E./B.Tech.) or a degree in Civil, Mechanical, Mining, or allied disciplines may be given preference. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the ANRF-PAIR project. Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive ₹37,000/- per month for the first two years and ₹42,000/- per month from the third year onwards. Project Manager consolidated pay starts at ₹60,000/- per month (as per ANRF norms up to ₹1,25,000/-), and Field Assistants receive ₹27,000/- per month plus HRA as per ANRF norms. Shared accommodation shall be provided in the hostel.

content_sections.heading: NIT Rourkela Junior Research Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidates will be required to assist in research, operations, and administrative tasks associated with the project. Duties include: Supporting Junior Research Fellows and Co-Principal Investigators with day-to-day operational logistics and experiment setups. Assisting the research team in field visits, surveys, and sample or data collection from mines and nearby industries. Conducting laboratory and experimental activities and maintaining field records. Drafting reports, maintaining survey forms, databases, and photographs.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. The interview mode is hybrid and is scheduled for 04 November 2026 at 11:00 AM at the department mentioned in Annexure-I of the notification. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed for the online or in-person interview. NIT Rourkela will not pay travel expenses for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Engagement is purely temporary and co-terminus with the completion of the project. No hard copies of the application need to be sent by post. Candidates appearing for their final examination may apply, provided the qualifying degree result is submitted by 30 November 2026. Selected candidates are required to register for the Ph.D. programme. Mereness of minimum qualification does not guarantee an invitation to the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many total vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies advertised across different posts, which include 2 Junior Research Fellow posts, 1 Project Manager post, and 2 Field Assistant posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NIT Rourkela Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the complete application by email is 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential qualification for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Post Graduate degree in basic science or a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through National Eligibility Tests like CSIR-UGC NET or GATE, or central government exams.

faq.question: Q4. What is the upper age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for applying is below 30 years as on the last date of receipt of applications, with relaxation up to 5 years for SC, ST, PWD, and female applicants, and 3 years for OBC non-creamy layer candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What salary will be paid to the Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow receives a consolidated salary of ₹37,000/- per month for the first and second years, and ₹42,000/- per month from the third year onwards.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee for applying to these project positions.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates must send a single merged PDF file containing their filled application form, mark sheets, and certificates via email to [email protected] with the advertisement number in the subject line.

faq.question: Q8. When will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The test or interview is scheduled for 04 November 2026 at 11:00 AM in a hybrid mode at NIT Rourkela.

faq.question: Q9. Is this appointment permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely temporary and contractual on a co-terminus basis with the ANRF-PAIR project, and does not confer any right to regular appointment at NIT Rourkela.

faq.question: Q10. Are allowances provided along with the fellowship?
faq.answer: Shared accommodation shall be provided in the hostel as per the project terms.
